title: Shadowspire Ninja 影峰登天
description: A vertical paper-cut ninja climb through a 1200-metre tower. Chain wall jumps to enter a flow state, spend chi on i-frame dashes, collect lantern dust to refill chi, and survive warning-pulsing spike traps across the Timber Hold, Wind Gallery and Star Pavilion. Three lives, lantern checkpoints every 150 m, and a persistent best-height record.
controls: A/D or Left/Right to move, Space to jump (coyote time, wall slide, wall jump), Shift to dash (costs chi, grants invincibility frames), P to pause, M to mute, R to restart. Touch controls appear on mobile: left/right pads, jump and dash buttons. Chain three wall jumps without landing to trigger a temporary flow speed and score boost.
author: LightGame
